verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page functions as a browsable catalog listing all 25 skills with one-line descriptions before installing, and the project was accepted into Claude Code's official plugin marketplace (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`), giving a real marketplace listing path. However there's no evidence of search functionality, ratings/leaderboard, or a third-party registry beyond the vendor's own page and one platform's marketplace. Missing for 10: independent/searchable registry across multiple platforms, community ratings or leaderboard, in-app search/filter capability.
